item.title: Review: Recess Zero Proof Grapefruit "Paloma" Craft Mocktail
item.description: This Zero Proof Grapefruit "Paloma" Craft Mocktail from Recess is refreshing and delicious. It's also packed with adaptogens for a mood boost, without the alcohol.

item.title: Review: Hand on Heart's 2020 Alcohol-Removed Cabernet Sauvignon
item.description: This light-bodied and alcohol-removed 2020 Cabernet Sauvignon red wine from "Hand on Heart" is light on the palate and fruit-forward. Ruby-red in color, this alcohol-free wine looks great in a wine glass.
